pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: scripts/docs/check-doc-sync.mjs:68 The doc-sync hook drops every path under scripts/ before it looks anything up in the map, and no reason is recorded for that. So a change to these gates' documented CLI contract (exit codes 0/2/3, `--no-prune`, recipe behaviour, all restated in CLAUDE.md) never creates a doc obligation, and the area is left out of coupling coverage altogether.

techniques.evidence: scripts/docs/check-doc-sync.mjs:68 The whole scripts/ tree, these gates included, is blanket-skipped and no map entry claims it. The standard asks for an explicit, reasoned allowlist; this one gives no reason, and the map's _comment only says skip patterns 'live inside the script'.

CLAUDE.md:63 The disk-check flag and exit-code contract (disk-check.mjs:391, :72-73) is restated in CLAUDE.md, and the same goes for flake-check at CLAUDE.md:42. That prose surface is not listed as owed by any change to these scripts, and no check compares the two.
